{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue to numeric by removing commas and casting to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Confirm the conversion worked
print("First few cleaned revenue values:")
print(sales['revenue_clean'].head())

# Check for any remaining non-numeric values
print("\nAny non-numeric revenue values?", sales['revenue_clean'].isna().sum())"}
